response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, with notable open-source contributions and deep systems thinking, but lacks explicit, recent, or documented experience with JVM tooling, Spring, or enterprise IDE development — key requirements for this role.
strengths: Strong full-stack and systems-level engineering background with diverse tech exposure
Active open-source contributor with tooling and IDE-adjacent projects (e.g., test runners, DLang libraries)
Proven ability to learn and ship complex systems across platforms and languages
concerns: No clear evidence of recent Java/Kotlin or JVM internals work in recent roles
Lacks demonstrated experience with Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise application servers
IDE tooling experience is implied but not documented — no mention of IntelliJ, Eclipse, LSP, or compiler APIs
